title: Equilibrium in closed constant-function market maker economies
abstract: arXiv:2608.23915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study equilibria in a closed, fee-free constant-function market maker (CFMM) economy with two assets and two traders. An interior state is a unilateral no-trade equilibrium exactly when the CFMM marginal price equals both traders' marginal rates of substitution. For an interior initial state, individually rational unilateral equilibria are Pareto optimal relative to the fixed CFMM invariant. A weak representative agent is obtained at each fixed equilibrium by weighted sup-convolution, whereas a state-independent strong representative agent exists exactly when traders share a common homothetic preference. Every interior feasible state is reachable through finitely many valid trades, and alternating utility-maximizing trades converge to a Pareto optimal unilateral equilibrium. We also derive conditions under which trading order produces a first-mover advantage or disadvantage in the first round.

translated_title: 封闭常数函数做市商经济中的均衡
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23915v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究了具有两种资产和两个交易者的封闭、免手续费常数函数做市商（CFMM）经济中的均衡。一个内部状态是单边无交易均衡，当且仅当CFMM边际价格等于两个交易者的边际替代率。对于内部初始状态，个体理性的单边均衡相对于固定的CFMM不变量是帕累托最优的。在每个固定均衡处，通过加权上卷积获得一个弱代表性代理，而状态无关的强代表性代理仅在交易者共享共同同质偏好时存在。每个内部可行状态都可以通过有限次有效交易达到，且交替效用最大化交易收敛于帕累托最优单边均衡。我们还推导了交易顺序在第一轮中产生先发优势或劣势的条件。
tldr: 该论文揭示了封闭CFMM经济中均衡的充要条件，并证明其帕累托最优性及可达性，同时分析了交易顺序对先发优势的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes equilibrium conditions in closed CFMM economies, proves Pareto optimality and reachability of equilibria, and analyzes first-mover effects in trading order.
